offers.name: AI Readiness assessment
offers.purpose: Give an executive one general view of organizational AI readiness.
offers.scope: General organizational assessment, usually completed by a CEO, COO or another executive. One assessment produces one organizational result across six areas: leadership and strategy, data, technology, talent, governance and responsible AI, and culture and change.
deliverables: One organizational AI readiness result across six areas
Supporting research for the two lowest areas
inputs: One general assessment, usually completed by the CEO, COO or another executive
poor_fit: Needs individual employee skills measurement or personalized department-specific results, rather than one general organizational view

claims.organization-profile: A general assessment, usually completed by a CEO, COO or another executive, producing one organizational AI readiness result across six areas.

prohibited: Free assessment delivering a transformation training plan

offers.not_to_be_confused_with: During a paid transformation, each person completes an individual personalized AI Readiness assessment tailored to their department.
